content.short: Parallax provides virtual USD accounts and stablecoin payouts for freelancers, contractors and global teams.
content.description: Parallax is a stablecoin-powered payments platform that gives freelancers, contractors and global teams virtual USD accounts and fast international payouts. Workers can receive salary or invoices in stablecoins such as USDC and USDT, hold a dollar balance, and convert and withdraw to local bank accounts or wallets, using blockchain rails across networks like Ethereum, Solana and Polygon to settle quickly and cheaply. For businesses, Parallax offers a way to pay distributed teams and contractors around the world without the delays and high fees of traditional cross-border payroll. By combining a USD account with stablecoin settlement and local cash-out, it helps people in emerging markets get paid in dollars and keep more of what they earn.
